identificationModule.briefTitle: Brief Title: Study of Efficacy and Safety of Canakinumab as Adjuvant Therapy in Adult Subjects With Stages AJCC/UICC v. 8 II-IIIA and IIIB (T>5cm N2) Completely Resected Non-small Cell Lung Cancer Acronym: CANOPY-A
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase III, Multicenter, Randomized, Double Blind, Placebo-controlled Study Evaluating the Efficacy and Safety of Canakinumab Versus Placebo as Adjuvant Therapy in Adult Subjects With Stages AJCC/UICC v. 8 II -IIIA and IIIB (T>5cm N2) Completely Resected (R0) Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

armGroups.label: canakinumab
armGroups.description: Participants received 200mg of canakinumab subcutaneously every 3 weeks for up to 18 cycles (approximately 54 weeks)

armGroups.label: Placebo
armGroups.description: Participants received canakinumab placebo subcutaneously every 3 weeks for up to 18 cycles (approximately 54 weeks)

interventions.name: Canakinumab
interventions.description: 200 mg of canakinumab administered subcutaneously on day 1 of every 21-day cycle for 18 cycles. Canakinumab solution for injection was provided by Novartis as ready-to-use pre-filled syringes to be administered by study personnel.

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: Placebo administered subcutaneously on day 1 of every 21-day cycle for 18 cycles. Placebo solution for injection was provided by Novartis as ready-to-use pre-filled syringes to be administered by study personnel.
